title: Engine: lost brief for every hung sibling, FIFO-safe report reads, multi-waiter test
lead: *Proposed.* After a pause of kind `lost`, every role whose newest record of the round ended `hung` or `lost` gets the "Earlier process lost" brief section on retry, not only the role the pending slot names. ork reads every role-written report file through one helper that never blocks on a FIFO and refuses anything but a regular file. A test pins the re-pick of two waiters behind a codex holder that hits a limit.
findings_note: 2026-11-17: S227 items re-verified at HEAD f48a6154. S182 item 1 (only the role named in pending gets the "Earlier process lost" section after two hung siblings), the S194 "found while verifying" FIFO item (role-written report files read with plain os.ReadFile, now at more sites than listed), and S169 item 3 (no test with two or more waiters behind a holder that hits a limit) are still present.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
E-class half of the S227 notes row (polish carried from S182, S169 and the S194 verification; each from a review and unverified). Re-verified at HEAD `f48a6154`:

- S182 item 1 (still present). `pause` keeps the first pause of a state (`internal/engine/engine.go:869-883`), so when the reviewer and the UI pass both hang, `endHungRound` (`internal/engine/watchdog.go:187-204`) records the second role `hung` but its `PendingLost` pause is dropped. On retry `pendFor` (`internal/engine/states.go:737-753`) returns the pending only to `p.Role`; the other role is not done (`reviewDone`, `states.go:775-792`: exit `hung` is not ok), so it runs again without the section (`pendingKindSection`, `internal/engine/round.go:277-278`; `Sections: append(pendingSection(pend), ...)`, `round.go:455`). The restart path has the same shape: it names every lost role in the reason but puts only `last.Role` in the pending (`internal/engine/recover.go:92-105`). `TestTwoHungSiblingRoundsPauseOnce` (`internal/engine/watchdog_test.go:571`) pins the single pause, and no test retries it.
- S194 new item, FIFO reads (still present, more sites). The report viewer reads through `readReport` with `openNoBlock` and a regular-file check (`internal/engine/report.go:47-79`, `internal/engine/openfile_unix.go:12-14`). Every other read of a role-written report uses `os.ReadFile`, which blocks on a FIFO: `internal/engine/round.go:169` (`earlierReports`), `round.go:1041` (refused report), `round.go:1112` (`readReport`, and its fallback `os.WriteFile` at `:1118` blocks on a FIFO with no reader), `internal/engine/states.go:149` (`feedbackSection`), `states.go:596` (`latestReport`), `states.go:764` (`roundReport`), `states.go:789` (`reviewDone`), `internal/engine/speccheck.go:568` (`readSpecReport`), `internal/agent/claude/report.go:17` (`ReadReport`), `internal/agent/codex/codex.go:280`, `internal/agent/grok/grok.go:395` and `grok.go:409`. The row's anchors (`round.go:578`, `speccheck.go:328`) have moved; grok's two reads are new since the note.
- S169 item 3 (still present). The waiter tests start one waiter only (`TestWaiterTakesAnotherRowWhenTheSlotHolderMarksTheVendorOut`, `internal/engine/fallback_test.go:1012-1046`; `TestWaiterLooksAgainWhenTheVendorIsMarkedOutWhileItWaits`, `:1048-1058`). No test queues two or more waiters behind a holder that hits a limit.

Owner decisions (2026-11-17): derive the lost section from the role record, with no new record field (adj 422); the safe read helper lives in `internal/clirun` (adj 434).

Not in this slice: any TUI or daemon change; the report viewer's own read (`report.go`, already safe); `orientation.md` (`round.go:458`, written by ork); check logs and `land.go` log reads (ork-written).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
Go, stdlib only, in the style of their neighbours. "Fails first" names why each is red before the change.

Lost brief (`internal/engine/watchdog_test.go`, `internal/engine/uipass_test.go`):

- `TestTwoHungSiblingsBothGetTheLostBriefOnRetry`: as `TestTwoHungSiblingRoundsPauseOnce`, with the silence behind an `atomic.Bool` as in `TestRetryAfterAHungRoleRunsTheSameRowWithTheLostBrief`. After the pause, `rec.Pending.Reason` contains both `reviewer round 1 hung: no output for` and `ui round 1 hung: no output for`, and `rec.Reason` equals it. Clear the silence, `e.Retry`. The retry requests for `reviewer` and for `ui` each contain `## Earlier process lost` and the pending reason. Fails first: the reason names one role, and the other role's brief has no section.
- `TestRestartLostSiblingsBothGetTheLostBriefOnRetry`: as `TestLostPauseNamesEveryLostRole` (seed `parallel-lost` in review with running reviewer 111 and ui 222, recover), then `Retry` with a runner that exits ok. Both the reviewer and the ui request contain `## Earlier process lost` and `reviewer round 1 lost` and `ui round 1 lost`. Fails first: only `last.Role` gets the section.
- `TestLostBriefIsNotRepeatedForANamedRole`: the single-role case of `TestRetryAfterAHungRoleRunsTheSameRowWithTheLostBrief`; the implementer brief contains `## Earlier process lost` exactly once. Passes on arrival; it pins that the new rule does not double the section.

FIFO reads:

- `TestReadRegularFileRefusesAFIFOWithoutBlocking` (`internal/clirun/readfile_test.go`, unix build tag): `syscall.Mkfifo(path, 0o600)`; `ReadRegularFile(path)` returns a non-nil error within 2 s (run it in a goroutine, `select` on a 2 s timer, `t.Fatal("blocked on a FIFO")`). A symlink to a regular file also returns an error; a regular file returns its bytes. Fails first: the helper does not exist.
- `TestReadReportFallsBackWhenTheReportIsAFIFO` (`internal/engine/report_fifo_unix_test.go`, unix build tag): a FIFO at the report path; `e.readReport(path, "implementer-1.md", "fallback text")` returns within 2 s with text `fallback text` and file `""`, and the path is still a FIFO. Fails first: `os.ReadFile` blocks (the test hits its 2 s timer).
- `TestEarlierReportsSkipAFIFO` (same file): a record with two role reports, the first a FIFO and the second a regular file with `Text two`; `earlierReports` returns within 2 s one report, `Text two`. Fails first: blocks.
- `TestClaudeReadReportUsesTheResultWhenTheFileIsAFIFO` (`internal/agent/claude`, unix build tag): `ReadReport(fifo, &Result{Text: "final"})` returns `("final", ReportFromResult)` within 2 s. Fails first: blocks.

Waiters (`internal/engine/fallback_test.go`):

- `TestTwoWaitersBothTakeAnotherRowWhenTheSlotHolderHitsALimit`: as `TestWaiterTakesAnotherRowWhenTheSlotHolderMarksTheVendorOut`, with two `startWaiter` runs queued before `close(release)`. Each waiter's first round runs on claude (`requireFirstRoundOnClaude` for each), `vendors.holders("codex")` is 0 after all runs end, and `vendors.IsOut("codex")`. May pass on arrival; it pins the behaviour the S169 review asked for. If it fails, the slice fixes the re-pick so it passes.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Tests first (write the tests above, run them, see them red for the stated reason), then:

1. `internal/clirun/readfile_unix.go` (`//go:build unix`): `ReadRegularFile(path string) ([]byte, error)` opens with `os.O_RDONLY|syscall.O_NONBLOCK|syscall.O_NOFOLLOW`, `Stat`s the open file, returns an error unless it is a regular file, then `io.ReadAll`. `OpenNoBlockWrite(path string, perm os.FileMode) (*os.File, error)` opens with `O_WRONLY|O_CREATE|O_TRUNC|O_NONBLOCK|O_NOFOLLOW`, then refuses a non-regular file. `readfile_other.go` (`//go:build !unix`): `os.Open` plus the regular-file check, and `os.OpenFile` for the write. Start both files with the SPDX line.
2. Replace each `os.ReadFile` listed under Why with `clirun.ReadRegularFile`; keep each call site's behaviour on error as it is (skip, fall back, or `(the file is gone)`). In `readReport` (`round.go:1107-1125`) write the fallback through `clirun.OpenNoBlockWrite`, so a FIFO at the path returns `fallback, ""` (the existing error branch). Leave `report.go` and `openfile_*.go` as they are.
3. `pause` (`engine.go:869`): when the slice is already paused with a `PendingLost` pending of the same state and round and the new pause is also `PendingLost`, append `"; " + p.Reason` to `r.Pending.Reason` and to `r.Reason`. Nothing else changes in `pause`.
4. Brief: add `lostSection(rec, r)`. When the role's newest record of this round and part (`r.is`) has exit `hung` or `lost`, `rec.Pending` is `PendingLost`, and `pendFor` did not already give this role that pending, prepend `BriefSection{Title: "Earlier process lost", Body: ...}` with the same body as `pendingKindSection` and `rec.Pending.Reason`. Use it where the round builds `Sections` (`round.go:455`). Do not change `pendFor` or `reviewDone`.
5. Docs: `docs/design.md` watchdog paragraph: every role of the state that ended `hung` or `lost` gets the section on retry, and a second hang adds its reason to the pause (*proposed*). Report-path paragraph: ork reads a report only when it is a regular file; a FIFO, a symlink or a device counts as no report file (*proposed*).
6. CHANGELOG.md: one new bullet at the end of `## Unreleased`: after two hung or lost sibling roles, a retry briefs both; role report files are read without blocking on a FIFO; a test pins two waiters re-picking a row (S227).
7. Do not touch `internal/tui`, `internal/daemon`, `internal/cli` or golden views.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:

- After the reviewer and the UI pass both hang, the pause reason names both roles, and a retry gives both briefs an `## Earlier process lost` section.
- After a restart finds two sibling roles lost, a retry gives both briefs the section.
- A FIFO at a report path never blocks the engine or a vendor adapter: every listed read returns within 2 s and treats it as no report file.
- Two waiters behind a codex holder that hits a limit both take the next row; no codex slot leaks.

Commands:

- `go vet ./...` exits 0.
- `go test -race -count=1 ./...` exits 0.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check --root /home/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork` exits 0.
- `adj lint` exits 0.
- `rg -n 'os\.ReadFile\(s\.ReportFile\)|os\.ReadFile\(path\); err == nil && strings\.TrimSpace' internal/agent internal/engine` prints nothing.
- `rg -n 'os\.ReadFile\(filepath\.Join\(e\.run\.Dir\(\), (r\.Report|file|fb\.File)\)\)' internal/engine` prints nothing.
